title: Squirrel with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail: big fluffy orange swirl -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='58' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#F4802A'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='52' rx='15' ry='19' fill='#FFA34D'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='47' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#FFC98A'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='68' rx='17' ry='21' fill='#F4802A'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='70' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#FFE3B8'/>
  <!-- Hind leg -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='82' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#D96A1E'/>
  <!-- Foot -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='88' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#B8541A'/>
  <!-- Front paw -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='80' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#D96A1E'/>
  <!-- Arm -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='72' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#F4802A'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='17' fill='#F4802A'/>
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='28' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#F4802A'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='28' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#FFC98A'/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='27' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#F4802A'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='27' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#FFC98A'/>
  <!-- Cheek -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='47' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#FFE3B8'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='46' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#FFF2DC'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#E0559A'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M24 47 Q26 50 29 48' stroke='#B8541A' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='37' r='5.5' fill='#4A1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='37' r='4' fill='#3A0F06'/>
  <!-- Sparkle big -->
  <path d='M34 32 L35 35.5 L38.5 36.5 L35 37.5 L34 41 L33 37.5 L29.5 36.5 L33 35.5 Z' fill='#FFFDF0'/>
  <!-- Sparkle small -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#FFFDF0'/>
  <!-- Second eye hint sparkle -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='34' r='1' fill='#FFE9A8'/>
  <!-- Whisker -->
  <path d='M20 43 L14 41' stroke='#D96A1E' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M20 46 L13 47' stroke='#D96A1E' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Fluffy tail highlight dots -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='48' r='2' fill='#FFE3B8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FFE3B8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='2' fill='#FFE3B8'/>
</svg>
